description:
Two SIMD equivalence test files return early when the host publishes no SIMD bundle, so they pass without comparing anything; a shared equivalence test always exercises at least one implementation and says which.

## Background

`crates/gf2-core/tests/simd_equiv_demo.rs` and `crates/gf2-core/tests/simd_equiv_dispatch_hoist.rs` compare SIMD kernels with their scalar references. Each test returns at once when feature detection finds no bundle, and the test is then reported as passed. On a host without AVX2, or in a build where detection is disabled, the suite reports equivalence that it did not check.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each test in the two files either runs its scalar reference assertions on every host or is reported as skipped, never as passed, when no SIMD implementation is available.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each test asserts that it exercised a non-zero number of implementations and names them in its output.
- [hard] REQ-03: A committed search record lists every test in the workspace that returns early on a missing SIMD bundle, and none remains outside this rule.

## Notes

Found while making the M4RM Gray-table contract test non-vacuous.
title: Stop SIMD equivalence tests passing without running on hosts without SIMD
